scripts.link: J=${JUNCO:-$HOME/git/junco}; mkdir -p node_modules/@earendil-works && ln -sfn "$J" node_modules/junco && for p in dataflow-engine dataflow-profile junco-frontend; do ln -sfn "$J/packages/$p" node_modules/$p || exit; done && for p in typebox typescript @types; do ln -sfn "$J/node_modules/$p" node_modules/$p || exit; done && for p in pi-agent-core pi-ai pi-coding-agent; do ln -sfn "$J/node_modules/@earendil-works/$p" node_modules/@earendil-works/$p || exit; done
scripts.loop: sh -c 'for arg do case $arg in --once|--prepare) echo "Invoke wf.ts directly for one-shot work" >&2; exit 64;; esac; done; while :; do bun run wf.ts "$@"; rc=$?; case $rc in 1) echo "Z3-pulse-loop: runtime failure; restarting in 60 s" >&2; sleep 60 || exit $?;; *) exit $rc;; esac; done' pulse-loop
